questions.question: 诗中‘举头望明月，低头思故乡’通过哪两个动作展现情感变化？这种写法有何作用？
questions.referenceAnswer: 通过‘举头’与‘低头’两个动作展现由外物触发到内心感怀的情感过程；二者形成动作对比，凝练而生动地写出思乡之情自然生发、难以抑制的心理状态。
questions.evidence: “举头” 与 “低头” 两个动作形成对比，写出思乡的过程。

questions.question: 从内容与结构角度看，《静夜思》前两句与后两句分别侧重描写什么？二者之间构成怎样的关系？
questions.referenceAnswer: 前两句侧重描写眼前所见之景（床前月光如霜），后两句转向内心所感之情（望月思乡）；景与情紧密相连，由景入情、情景交融，自然完成从外在感知到内在抒怀的过渡。
questions.evidence: “疑是地上霜” 运用了比喻……“举头” 与 “低头” 两个动作形成对比，写出思乡的过程。

questions.question: In triangle ABC, if angle A = 50° and angle B = 25°, explain whether it is true that BC = 2AC. Use the sine formula and your reasoning.
questions.referenceAnswer: Angle C = 180° - 50° - 25° = 105°. By the sine formula, \(\frac{BC}{\sin 50^\circ} = \frac{AC}{\sin 25^\circ}\). So \(BC = 1.81 \times AC\). Since 1.81 ≠ 2, BC ≠ 2AC. Therefore, the statement is false.
questions.evidence: In \(\triangle ABC\), \(\angle C = 50^\circ + 25^\circ = 180^\circ\) \(\therefore \angle C = 105^\circ\). \(\frac{BC}{\sin 50^\circ} = \frac{AC}{\sin 25^\circ}\) \(\Rightarrow BC = 1.81 \, AC\) \(\therefore \text{False}\)

questions.question: In triangle ABC, if angle A = 45°, side a = 5 cm, and side c = 5\sqrt{2} cm, can triangle ABC be formed? Explain using the sine formula.
questions.referenceAnswer: By the sine formula, \(\frac{5\sqrt{2}}{\sin C} = \frac{5}{\sin 45^\circ}\). Solving gives \(\sin C = 1\), so \(C = 90^\circ\). Since \(-1 \le \sin C \le 1\), and \(\sin C = 1\) is valid, triangle ABC can be formed.
questions.evidence: By the sine formula, \(\frac{(5\sqrt{2})}{\sin C} = \frac{(5)}{\sin(45^\circ)}\) \(\Rightarrow \sin C = 1\) \(\Rightarrow C = 90^\circ\) \(\therefore \triangle ABC\) (can / cannot) be formed.

questions.question: In triangle ABC, if angle A = 25°, side a = 11 cm, and side c = 27 cm, is there a valid solution? Explain your reasoning using the sine formula.
questions.referenceAnswer: Using the sine formula, \(\frac{27}{\sin C} = \frac{11}{\sin 25^\circ}\), so \(\sin C = \frac{27 \sin 25^\circ}{11} \approx 1.04 > 1\). Since \(\sin C\) cannot be greater than 1, there is no valid solution.
questions.evidence: 16. \(A = 25^\circ\), \(a = 11\) cm, \(c = 27\) cm. \(\frac{27}{\sin C} = \frac{11}{\sin 25^\circ}\) \(\Rightarrow \sin C \approx 1.04 > 1\) \(\therefore\) no solution.
